title: Chetan Prakash shows quantum wave functions arise from Markov chains

tellings.quote: what what u my collaborator Shaon Pash has shown in in in certain cases and we think it's I think it's quite general is that the quantum wave functions for free particles are precisely the same thing

plain: The scientist Donald Hoffman tells Michels that his collaborator, the mathematician Chetan Prakash, has shown that in certain cases the quantum wave functions of free particles, the math physicists use to describe a particle on its own, are "precisely the same thing" as Markov chains, a model in which a system hops from state to state at random by fixed odds. Hoffman says he thinks the result is "quite general." If so, it would suggest that the basic stuff of physics comes out of a simpler, deeper process, which is the core of Hoffman's view.
